itens.trecho: Da Rússia, com amor. No segundo filme da franquia 007, o agente britânico James Bond é o alvo de uma conspiração da organização criminosa SPECTRE, que planeia assassiná-lo usando as forças soviéticas como engodo, em especial uma bela e ingénua agente russa.

There's a saying in England: Where there's smoke, there's fire! From Russia With Love is directed by Terence Young and adapted to screenplay by Richard Maibaum & Johanna Harwood from the Ian Fleming novel of the same name. It stars Sean Connery, Daniela Bianchi, Lotte Lenya, Robert Shaw & Pedro Armendáriz.

SPECTRE agents, Istanbul, Gypsies, beautiful women and the Orient Express Agent 007 (Sean Connery) is sent on a dubious mission at Istanbul to possibly acquire a Lektor cryptography device from the Soviets via their consulate.
